newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares shake off weakness to end at record.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares shake off weakness to end at record.

text.p: 1440 GMT - Swiss shares shook off early weakness to end at a record closing high, propelled by a firming U.S. dollar which drove stocks of export-dependent firms higher.

Dealers said early gains on Wall Street and derivatives-linked transactions were also behind the rise. "We have seen extreme moves in some shares, which points to a lot of action in derivatives," one trader noted.
"As long as the environment stays like this, people will keep buying," he added. Activity was described as lively.
* The blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI) ended up 37.9 points, or 0.76 percent, at 5,042.6.
